- [decision] Rounding in currency conversion (id: 01a10c1f-72de-7631-9547-c3730c91db54; source: shared/human)
  Currency conversion rounds toward negative infinity (`decimal.ROUND_FLOOR`) to the target minor unit, so a conversion never credits a customer more than the rate allows. Treasury decision, April 2026; deliberately different from tax rounding.
- [decision] Rounding in proration (id: 01a10c1f-7fa7-7cd2-bb96-d6ad0006eecf; source: shared/human)
  Proration keeps full Decimal precision for the unused fraction and rounds only the final amount, to the cent, with `decimal.ROUND_HALF_DOWN`: an exact half cent stays with Acme, because the customer is already receiving a credit (Billing Ops decision BOPS-41). Never round the daily or per-second rate on its own.","hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit"}}
